top_signals.title: Indonesia Unveils $117 Million in Fines After MSCI Warning
top_signals.summary: Indonesia announced about $117 million in fines tied to manipulative market practices involving three companies, hours after global index provider MSCI Inc. said it was weighing a downgrade of the country’s stock market over investability concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
